editorial.blurb: PLANTA Chicago serves inventive vegan cuisine in an intimate, beautifully lit setting where creative plant-based dishes like Bang Bang Broccoli and eggplant nigiri shine.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for recommendations and allow yourself extra time—the food is worth the patient wait, and kind staff like Macy and Erin elevate the experience with thoughtful explanations.

topDishes.note: Lightly fried with an amazing sauce, consistently praised
Unique with a delicious kick of spice
